name: Night's Watch absorbs 25% of a physical hit and repays it as a self-DoT (#9018)
contract: Night's Watch 807733's client tooltip only documents its threat bonus; the 25% physical-damage absorb and
its deferred self-inflicted repayment are a CoA-custom addition layered on top
hit's IMMEDIATE health loss to 75% of the raw amount on the spot: absorb = damage/4 (integer division), the
remaining 75% applies instantly, and the absorbed 25% is spread across a 5-slot ring buffer, paid back by
Tick() (1000 ms amplitude) at one slot per second over the next 5 seconds. Jeklik's Crushing Blow (24257) is
a fixed-size (200-220, DieSides 21) melee-class Physical hit a hostile creature can be forced to cast
directly via the harness's creature 'cast' action, giving a single, controlled, non-combat-RNG hit instead
of relying on live auto-attack timing or weapon rolls. For a hit in that range, absorb (floor(raw/4)) and
the resulting immediate/deferred split land within about 1% of an exact 1:3 ratio, so the deferred
repayment, measured once no further hit occurs, must equal roughly a third of the immediate loss. A control
repeats the same single hit with no Night's Watch active and confirms no repayment follows it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: health before the unbuffed hit
The control mob lands one fixed physical hit, no Night's Watch
CONTROL: health right after that one hit
Past the 5 s window Night's Watch would use to repay a debt
CONTROL: no further health loss follows without Night's Watch
The buffed mob lands the same fixed physical hit
Health right after the buffed hit
That hit's immediate loss, roughly 75% of the raw hit (a negative delta)
Let all 5 debt-repayment ticks fire (5 s window, plus margin)
DISCRIMINATING: the deferred repayment is roughly a third of that same hit's immediate loss (25/75)
